nodes.question: What broader impact did the COVID-19 pandemic have beyond health concerns according to the provided information?
nodes.answer: Beyond health concerns, the COVID-19 pandemic had negative effects on socio-economic developments, leading to a global crisis marked by economic decline and increased poverty and hunger.
